title: Intersection cardinality as an indicator sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $U,J$ be finite subsets of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$. The cardinality of their intersection, viewed as a real number, is $\\sum_{i\\in U}\\mathbf{1}_{J}(i)$, where $\\mathbf{1}_{J}(i)$ is $1$ if $i\\in J$ and $0$ otherwise.
